description: This file is a shell script used for testing Unicode normalization (NFD to NFC) handling in Git, involving creation and manipulation of files with decomposed and precomposed UTF-8 characters, and testing Git commands like diff, log, stage, checkout, and others in relation to Unicode normalization.

methods.name: ls_files_nfc_nfd
methods.description: Function that sets up a Git repository with specific unicode precompose settings and tests if files with Unicode normalization differences are correctly handled by Git commands.
